summary: Managed Google Play closed test: 12 human testers on real Android devices use your app daily for 14 consecutive days, managed end to end until production access is approved.

public_price.covers: 12 testers, 14 days, replacement at no extra cost if a tester drops, Play Console setup help

pricing.pricing_note: One engagement, one price: €200 flat. No per-tester add-ons, no tiers.

intake_method: web form (temporary) plus the live A2A endpoint (logs the request and notifies a human; no prices through the endpoint)
api_surface_today: a static availability file, that temporary form, and the live A2A endpoint (logging-and-notify intake, not a pricing API)
human_approves: Yacine (accountable human) authorises the order before anyone is engaged, the booking is binding, or payment is arranged
client_approval: The client/developer confirms the booking before anything is arranged
automated_today: a2a request logging and human notification
service_area_and_language: Worldwide, remote; timezone Europe/Paris; languages English and French

body.category: one of: Productivity, Games, Education, Health and fitness, Finance, Social and communication, Tools and utilities, Lifestyle, Other
body.profile: 'Solo creator, flat-rate' or 'Multiple apps or studio'
body.handle: optional, only if contact is not email

order_policy.note: Every order waits for Yacine's authorisation and the client's booking confirmation before anything is arranged. Payment is only ever arranged with a human, never through the intake endpoint.
order_policy.consent: Software acting for a person should only submit an inquiry with that person's consent and their own contact details, or email quotes@kubeai.info.

a2a_note: A2A v1.0 JSON-RPC: Send Message (request_quote, book_cohort) plus Get Task; streaming and push not supported; the endpoint logs requests and notifies a human, it does not compute or return a price; no payments through the endpoint. The published service price is €200 flat per engagement.
